js: const items=['Atlas','Bravo','Charlie','Delta','Echo','Foxtrot','Gamma']; const list=root.querySelector('[data-list]'),input=root.querySelector('[data-filter]'),empty=root.querySelector('[data-empty]'); const render=()=>{const q=input.value.trim().toLowerCase();const shown=items.filter(x=>x.toLowerCase().includes(q));list.replaceChildren(...shown.map(x=>{const li=document.createElement('li');li.textContent=x;return li;}));empty.hidden=shown.length!==0;}; input.addEventListener('input',render);render();
